Crossvault Capital Management LLC reduced its holdings in Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 0.6% during the fourth quarter, according to its most recent 13F filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The fund owned 65,279 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 399 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for about 5.8% of Crossvault Capital Management LLC’s investment portfolio, making the stock its largest position. Crossvault Capital Management LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $11,047,000 as of its most recent SEC filing. 
A number of other hedge funds and other institutional investors have also made changes to their positions in AAPL. FNY Managed Accounts LLC increased its position in shares of Apple by 852.4% during the 2nd quarter. FNY Managed Accounts LLC now owns 800 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $115,000 after purchasing an additional 716 shares during the last quarter. Private Vista LLC bought a new position in shares of Apple during the 2nd quarter valued at about $122,000. Crow Point Partners LLC increased its position in shares of Apple by 100.0% during the 3rd quarter. Crow Point Partners LLC now owns 1,000 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $153,000 after purchasing an additional 500 shares during the last quarter. Oak Point Wealth Management bought a new position in shares of Apple during the 4th quarter valued at about $163,000. Finally, Interactive Financial Advisors bought a new position in shares of Apple during the 4th quarter valued at about $188,000. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 61.35% of the company’s stock. 
Several equities analysts have recently commented on the company. Nomura reiterated a “neutral” rating and set a $175.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research report on Monday, March 19th. BidaskClub cut Apple from a “hold” rating to a “sell” rating in a report on Friday, January 26th. BMO Capital Markets cut Apple from an “outperform” rating to a “market perform” rating and increased their target price for the company from $162.00 to $166.00 in a report on Wednesday, January 31st. William Blair restated an “outperform” rating on shares of Apple in a report on Friday, February 2nd. Finally, Bank of America restated an “outperform” rating and set a $220.00 target price on shares of Apple in a report on Thursday, February 8th. Two analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have given a hold rating, thirty-two have assigned a buy rating and one has given a strong buy rating to the stock. Apple has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $203.21. In other news, insider Luca Maestri sold 39,122 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction on Friday, April 13th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.66, for a total value of $6,833,048.52. Following the transaction, the insider now directly owns 64,475 shares in the company, valued at approximately $11,261,203.50. The transaction was disclosed in a document filed with the SEC, which is accessible through this link . Also, SVP Daniel J. Riccio sold 17,375 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction on Wednesday, April 4th. The stock was sold at an average price of $169.12, for a total value of $2,938,460.00. Following the completion of the transaction, the senior vice president now owns 66,191 shares in the company, valued at $11,194,221.92. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last three months, insiders sold 125,988 shares of company stock valued at $21,336,201. Corporate insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock. 
Apple stock opened at $172.80 on Friday. The firm has a market capitalization of $904,392.13, a price-to-earnings ratio of 18.76, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.35 and a beta of 1.25. Apple has a 12 month low of $141.16 and a 12 month high of $183.50. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a current ratio of 1.24 and a quick ratio of 1.20. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 EPS for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. The business had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The company’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same quarter last year, the company earned $3.36 EPS. equities research analysts forecast that Apple will post 11.37 earnings per share for the current year. 
Apple Company Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
